unpublishedNotice: This track's public page is closed: what you enter here will only show once it is opened, from the track details.
leaveConfirm: Some changes to the page are not saved. Leave anyway?

place.title: Venue and presentation
place.intro: Where the track takes place, the tagline under its title and the audiences it addresses.

media.title: Header and documents
media.intro: The header photo and the documents to download: programme, summary, guide.

feature.title: Featured block
feature.intro: One block per page, for what must stand out: the Negotiators' Guide for the workshop, for instance.

partners.title: Partners
partners.intro: Organisations behind or supporting the day, distinct from those of its activities. The list order is the page order.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.intro: The parts of the day, the track's activities and the moments without an activity. Each change is saved at once.

place.venueHint: With no choice, the edition's pavilion. Another venue (the workshop hotel) is declared in the "Venues and rooms" tab.
place.noAddress: No address and no map link: the page will show no access map.
place.taglineHint: A few words under the title: "Hackathon, pitches, game, stage".

audiences.label: Target audiences
audiences.hint: One audience per line. French is required, English optional.

media.documentsHint: As PDF. The label is the link text on the page: "Programme (PDF)", "Guide summary".
media.caption: Link label
media.captionHint: Without a label, the page shows the file name.

feature.kickerHint: One line above the title: "Presented during the workshop".
feature.title: Block title
feature.titleMissing: A featured block needs a title: without it, nothing shows.
feature.urlInvalid: Full address (https://…) or a site path starting with "/".
feature.urlMissing: A link label needs its address.

partners.supportNoteHint: One sentence printed under the logos, in the funder's words: "With financial support from the Government of Québec".

parts.heading: Parts
parts.intro: An editorial grouping ("Morning", "Part 1: financing adaptation"); its times are read from what it contains.
parts.empty: No part: the agenda will show as a single block.
parts.dialogHint: A short name, a heading, or both.
parts.label: Short name
parts.labelHint: "Morning", "Get inspired". Without a name, the page writes "Part 1".
parts.title: Heading
parts.summaryHint: For the overview at the top of the page.
parts.headingMissing: Give a short name or a heading.
parts.removeDescription: Its activities and moments stay in the agenda, outside any part.

agenda.title: Activities and moments
agenda.intro: Time zone: {zone}. Activities are attached to the track from the planner; here, you place them in a part and pick the highlights.

empty.title: Empty agenda
empty.description: Attach activities to the track from the planner, or add a moment (welcome, lunch, closing).

moments.dialogHint: Welcome, lunch, break, closing: not an activity, no registration nor broadcast.
moments.label: Label
moments.endHint: Optional: a closing may only have a start time.
moments.endBeforeStart: The end must follow the start.
moments.descriptionHint: Under the label, one bullet per line: "Address by the OIF".
moments.removeTitle: Remove this moment from the agenda?
